messages:
Zoe: Hey folks — got a PM visiting Canary Wharf at 12:30, wants something quick but not cafeteria food. Any sandwich vs curry recs that are <10 min walk?
Raj: For quick+reliable: `Pret` on South Quay — decent salad bowls and hot sandwiches, 4–6 min from the station.
Marie: If they want curry, `Masala Zone` on Jubilee Pl. is tasty but might be a 12 min walk and a queue at lunch.
Joel: Not a fan of queues — +1 to Pret. If vegan, try `Club Mexicana` (walkable) for fast burrito bowls.
Zoe: Awesome, thanks. Any halal options nearby? Visitor prefers halal.
Raj: `The Halal Guys` at Canary Wharf is solid and fast, 6–8 min. Good for takeout — gyro/platters.
Marie: Also `Biryani Pot` on Canada Square does quick takeaway biryani (halal).
Ava: Quick poll? What should I recommend in order of priority: 1) fastest, 2) halal, 3) sit-down? React with :one:, :two:, or :three:.
Joel: :two: (halal)
Raj: :one: (fastest)
Marie: :two: (halal)
Zoe: :two: thanks — leaning halal takeout. Any tips on pickup to avoid lines?
Raj: Order on the app if available (some places do Deliveroo/JustEat pickup). Or call ahead — The Halal Guys usually can hold an order for 10 min.
Ava: FYI lunchbot: set reminder for Zoe to place pickup at 12:15.
lunchbot: Reminder set for <@Zoe> at 12:15 to place pickup order.
Zoe: Perfect — I'll recommend The Halal Guys and Biryani Pot as backups. Appreciate it :thumbsup:
Marie: If they want something sit-down after, `Roka` nearby is great for post-lunch catchups (not cheap).
Joel: Cheers — hope they like it!
